name: TextureUsage
doc: Semantic texture usage selects transfer functions, mip filtering and BC format.

variants.name: color
variants.doc: sRGB color (alpha remains linear), BC7 sRGB.

variants.name: normal
variants.doc: Tangent-space normals, normalized mips and BC5 XY.

variants.name: mask
variants.doc: A single linear scalar channel, BC4.

variants.name: lut
variants.doc: A colour lookup table strip (post-process volumes' grading): values kept as authored, uncompressed RGBA half floats, without mips.
